intro: Some beds are just furniture; Stud is an experience—a haven of comfort, style, and organisation. A perfect balance of beauty and practicality, it makes every moment in bed feel like a little luxury.

features.title: Duo-toned design for modern elegance
features.text: The sleek, two-tone finish brings a fresh, contemporary look to your bedroom, effortlessly blending with various décor styles while adding sophistication.

features.title: Cushioned headboard for luxurious comfort
features.text: The soft, cushioned headboard offers ultimate comfort, perfect for relaxing, reading, or lounging in bed, adding both style and functionality to your space.

features.title: Pull-out and box storage for easy access
features.text: Maximise your space with a combination of pull-out and box storage—store frequently used items in the pull-out section, while the box storage keeps larger essentials neatly organised.

features.title: Practical headboard ledge for daily essentials
features.text: Designed for easy access, the practical ledge on the headboard is perfect for placing your phone, books, or décor, adding extra utility to your space.

features.title: Crafted to last, made to impress
features.text: Crafted from high-quality engineered wood, this bed ensures lasting strength, offering both reliability and a sleek, modern aesthetic that’s built to withstand everyday use.

name: Stud Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Pullout Storage
